# Ethan Wood

EthanWood## Ethan Wood
### Tenure
2006– Present
### Title
Senior Director, Product Design
**Ethan Wood**is an American industrial designer currently serving as the Senior Director of Product Design at Mattel. While not technically a member of Hot Wheels'sdesign team, he is responsible for the design of a number of Hot Wheels-branded products found in theMattel Creations Collaboratory.
